notes: v1.20: Live MCX rates banner on the Dashboard — gold + silver from mcxlive.org, auto-scrolling, refreshed every 60 seconds in the background, with Refresh and Pause buttons; offline keeps the last rate marked OFFLINE. Gold per 10 g, silver per 1 kg, with the site's own As-on and last-trade times shown, so a closed-market last close is never passed off as live. Note: mcxlive.org has no public per-minute API, so the banner shows the site's latest Last Trade table on each minute's fetch. Includes v1.19 (B/Space shortcuts, sale -> Amount, 4-decimal weights, Attendance tab), v1.18 (Box Out horizontal scrolling), v1.17 (Return->Sell notification), v1.16 (return first then sell), v1.15 (version always visible), v1.14 (gold cell, autocomplete), v1.13 (gold row/field/header), v1.12 (horizontal sale row), v1.11 (keyboard Sell panel, Added column, Reset), v1.10 (manual cell entry), v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
